questions.verdict: FinanceRateCalc not found at all: neither the Pulte lender page nor the HF mirror. The engine declined to fabricate an FHA-only figure, which is the right behaviour, and quoted a third publisher with a third basis for the same statistic (principal reason only, 66%) — alongside our current basis (88.4%, any of four reasons) and our stale mirror's basis (62.8%, share of citations). Three bases for one 'DTI share' now circulate. Not QSI-scored (no FRC figure quoted).

summary: Fifth engine probed; FRC not found; a third publisher (Finantrix, unverified) and a third basis for the DTI reason share observed.
